textos.As reviews negativas reclamam que o film: The negative reviews complain that the film is dominated by dirt, excrement, vomit and other bodily fluids, used gratuitously and repetitively, making the experience repulsive rather than artistic.
textos.Muitos espectadores consideram o ritmo a: Many viewers consider the dragging pace and long running time a test of patience, with no narrative reward, with scenes that seem to repeat indefinitely.
textos.A falta de uma linha narrativa clara e a: The lack of a clear narrative line and the feeling that the story is going nowhere are frequent criticisms, with incoherent dialogue and random events.
textos.As críticas apontam personagens repulsiv: The criticisms point to repulsive characters, exaggerated performances and the absence of anyone to care about, with gratuitous, irritating behavior.
textos.Alguns consideram o filme pretensioso, c: Some consider the film pretentious, with a banal or nonexistent message, and directorial decisions that seem to mock the viewer's patience.
textos.Cinematografia e design de produção elog: Cinematography and production design praised, but they don't save it
textos.Apesar de reconhecerem a qualidade técni: Although they acknowledge the technical quality and the world-building, the critics say this does not make up for the unpleasant, tedious experience.
textos.Imersão sensorial no grotesco (sujeira,: Sensory immersion in the grotesque (dirt, fluids, filth)
textos.Este grupo destaca que o filme é extrema: This group highlights that the film is extremely immersive in its depiction of dirt, with bodies, settings and objects covered in mud, blood, urine and feces, causing a physical sense of revulsion and discomfort.
textos.Várias reviews medianas relatam que a hi: Several middling reviews report that the story is confusing and hard to understand, with unintelligible dialogue and a lack of clarity about who the characters are and what is happening, requiring outside reference to understand the plot.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas apontam que o ri: Many middling reviews point out that the pace is dragging and that the running time of almost three hours becomes tiring, with long stretches in which nothing significant happens.
textos.As reviews medianas elogiam a fotografia: The middling reviews praise the black-and-white cinematography, the elaborate long takes and the restless camera that moves in close on faces, creating a unique, hypnotic aesthetic.
textos.Este grupo reconhece o enorme trabalho d: This group acknowledges the enormous production design and costume work, which builds a dirty, cruel and visually coherent medieval world, with obsessive attention to detail.
textos.Várias reviews medianas consideram a pre: Several middling reviews consider the science-fiction premise on a medieval planet intriguing, but feel that the adaptation does not explore it well and that the result is confusing and not very engaging.
textos.As reviews destacam que o filme cria um: The reviews highlight that the film creates a world so dense and tactile that the viewer feels transported into it, with sets, costumes and details that spill off the screen and make the experience almost documentary-like.
textos.Muitas reviews enfatizam a presença cons: Many reviews emphasize the constant presence of mud, excrement, blood and other filth, describing the film as repulsive and at the same time fascinating, with an aesthetic that provokes everything from disgust to a need for a shower after the screening.
textos.Narrativa confusa e difícil de acompanha: Confusing narrative that is hard to follow
textos.Este grupo aponta que a trama é fragment: This group points out that the plot is fragmented and practically incomprehensible, requiring patience or outside research to be minimally understood, and that the film makes no effort to make it easier to follow.
textos.As reviews elogiam a fotografia em preto: The reviews praise the black-and-white cinematography, the long shots and the camera that moves restlessly and intrusively, creating a sense of claustrophobia and immersion that many consider a technical and artistic achievement.
textos.Várias reviews interpretam o filme como: Several reviews interpret the film as an allegory about violence, stupidity, authoritarianism and the human condition, portraying an oppressive world with no way out that serves as a reflection of historical and social issues.
textos.Algumas reviews comentam que as quase tr: Some reviews comment that the nearly three hours of running time and the slow pace make the experience tiring and demand effort, although others see this same aspect as part of the immersion the film proposes.
textos.busca uma imersão tátil em um universo d: want a tactile immersion in a dense, richly detailed universe
textos.se interessa por uma estética visceral e: are interested in a visceral, raw aesthetic that provokes fascination and revulsion
textos.aprecia planos longos e fotografia em pr: appreciate long takes and black-and-white cinematography with an intrusive camera
textos.tolera uma longa duração e andamento len: tolerate a long running time and slow pace in exchange for deeper immersion
textos.se incomoda com o excesso de sujeira e f: are bothered by an excess of dirt and repulsive bodily fluids
textos.se cansa com narrativas longas de andame: get tired of long narratives with a dragging pace and repetitive scenes
textos.rejeita histórias sem fio condutor claro: reject stories without a clear throughline, with incoherent dialogue and disconnected events
textos.acha que apuro técnico e visual não comp: feel that technical and visual polish does not make up for an unpleasant, tedious experience
textos.Lançado em 2013 e dirigido por Aleksei G: Released in 2013 and directed by Aleksei German Sr., the science-fiction drama Hard to Be a God follows a group of scientists sent to the planet Arkanar, whose civilization is at the stage equivalent to the Middle Ages of its own history, with the aim of guiding it toward progress without resorting to violence. Amid this setting, the scientist Rumata tries to save the local intellectuals from punishment and finds himself unable to avoid taking a side.
textos.A experiência de visualização se apoia e: The viewing experience rests on a dense atmosphere, with a setting marked by the constant presence of mud, dirt and bodily fluids in detailed shots. The narrative structure adopts a slow, measured pace over nearly three hours, with a fragmented, hermetic handling.
textos.Os diferentes grupos analisados concorda: The different groups analyzed agree on the central traits that make up the film, disagreeing on the verdict about how well the work functions. In the vast majority of ratings (~73%), the largest share highlights the deep sensory immersion and the density of the universe built, while close to half emphasize the omnipresence of dirt, filth and revulsion, and about half report having to face a confusing narrative that is hard to follow.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~16%), sob a óti: In a share of the ratings (~16%), from this group's standpoint, most examine the sensory immersion in the grotesque and in bodily fluids, about half point to the difficulty of following the narrative, and a considerable number stress the slow pace tied to the long running time. Finally, in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~11%), in the reading of these reviews, a large portion criticize the excessive filth and disgust, half of them reject the slow pace and excessive length, and a significant share point to the script's lack of cohesion.
